title: [autoopt] 20260413-1-trie-changeset-merge
body:
# Merge sorted trie changeset lookups into one cursor walk
## Evidence
- `bench-reth-results/baseline-1/samply-profile.json.gz` shows the `trie-input` worker spending 98.42% inclusive in `reth_trie::changesets::compute_trie_changesets`, with 94.94% of samples flowing through `InMemoryTrieCursor::seek_exact` and 73.30% through `cursor_seek`.
- The same profile shows `node_key` (30.20%), `Nibbles::len` (13.88%), and branch-node decode work on that thread, which is consistent with paying repeated per-key cursor overhead while computing deferred trie changesets.
- `crates/trie/trie/src/changesets.rs` was doing one `seek_exact` per already-sorted updated path for both account and non-wiped storage tries.

## Hypothesis
If we turn sorted changeset lookups into a single forward cursor walk, gas throughput improves by ~0.3-0.8% because deferred trie changeset computation does less repeated seek/setup work for every changed trie node.

## Success Metric
- gas_per_second (mgas_s.pct in summary.json) improves by >0.3%

## Plan
- Update `crates/trie/trie/src/changesets.rs` to merge-walk sorted update paths with one forward trie cursor pass instead of repeated `seek_exact` calls.
- Keep wiped-storage handling unchanged.
- Verify with `cargo check -p reth-trie` and `cargo test -p reth-trie changesets`.
